title: Retail Sales Performance Report – FY 2023‑2024
executive_summary: In fiscal year 2023‑2024 the company generated $445,325.09 in revenue across 520 orders, yielding an average order value of $856.39. Revenue grew 10.08% year‑over‑year, driven by strong performance in the East and North regions. Quarterly revenue in 2024 rose through Q3 before a modest dip in Q4. High‑discount electronics orders (≥20% off) contributed $50,035.33 from 22 orders. Revenue distribution is skewed, with a mean of $856.39 but a median of $313.28 and a maximum order of $7,844.02. Customer concentration is moderate: 222 unique customers, with the top customer accounting for 6.24% of total revenue.

key_findings.statement: Overall, the business recorded total revenue of $445,325.09 from 520 orders, resulting in an average order value of $856.39.
Regional revenue ranking places the East region highest ($130,516.69), followed by North ($124,845.75), West ($99,428.16), and South ($90,534.49).
Quarterly revenue in 2024 increased from Q1 ($36,108.31) to Q3 ($71,674.99) before a slight decline in Q4 ($68,948.71).
Total revenue grew from $211,976.29 in 2023 to $233,348.80 in 2024, a year‑over‑year increase of 10.08% (difference of $21,372.51).
There were 22 high‑discount (≥20%) electronics orders, generating $50,035.33 in revenue.
Order revenue distribution shows a mean of $856.39, median of $313.28, standard deviation $1,295.74, with values ranging from $5.27 to $7,844.02.
The dataset contains 222 distinct customers; the top‑spending customer contributed $27,793.13, representing 6.24% of total revenue.

limitations: The data reflects only recorded orders; returns, cancellations, or post‑sale adjustments are not captured.
Discount percentages are taken as reported; the underlying discount policies or promotional periods are unknown.
Customer identifiers are anonymized, limiting the ability to link revenue to broader customer demographics.
Revenue figures are gross; cost of goods sold, shipping, and other expenses are not included, so profitability cannot be assessed.
conclusion: Retail sales showed solid growth in FY 2023‑2024, with a 10% year‑over‑year increase and strong performance in the East and North regions. Quarterly trends indicate momentum through mid‑year, while high‑discount electronics remain a notable revenue source. Revenue distribution is highly skewed, and a modest concentration exists among top customers. Addressing data gaps around returns and cost structures will enable deeper profitability insights in future analyses.
